agents.caption: An agent adds a persona and sandbox tools; tool-capable models loop until done.
agents.hint: Every tool runs in the sandbox. Models without tool support run the task without the agent loop.
agents.title: Agents
artifacts.caption: Files produced by the models. They only ever execute inside the sandbox.
artifacts.iframe_note: Rendered in an isolated iframe (scripts allowed, no access to this app, cookies or storage).
artifacts.no_browser: No headless browser in this sandbox (start Docker or install playwright).
artifacts.process_warning: Executed as a local subprocess (Docker not available): weaker isolation.
artifacts.title: Artifacts
common.name: Name
compare.caption: Pick one run to compare its models, or several runs (e.g. an original and its re-run).
compare.hint: The first series is the baseline; deltas are relative to it.
compare.title: Compare
dash.no_runs: No runs yet: open Batteries and run the seed battery.
dash.warn_firestore: Data is stored in local SQLite. Configure Firestore in Settings to persist it in the cloud.
dash.warn_judge: No judge model configured: results will only get automatic scores until you review them.
dash.warn_only_fake: Only the offline fake models exist. Add a real provider and models in Models.
dash.warn_sandbox: Docker is not running: artifacts run as local subprocesses with weaker isolation.
header.backend_tip: Where results are stored. Configure Firestore in Settings.
header.sandbox_docker_tip: Artifacts run in isolated containers without network.
header.sandbox_down_tip: Sandbox mode is Docker but the daemon is not reachable: checks and replays will fail. Start Docker Desktop or switch the mode in Settings.
header.sandbox_process_tip: Docker is not available: artifacts run as local subprocesses (weaker isolation).
logs.indexes_caption: When Firestore needs a composite index, its creation link shows up here. Copy it and open it in the Firebase console.
logs.title: Application log
models.added: Added “{name}”. Tune it from the profile list above.
models.base_url_required: This provider needs a base URL
models.catalog_hint: Curated catalog with capabilities and prices. One click creates a ready-to-run profile.
models.inferred_note: Capabilities and prices inferred from the live model list; review them.
models.keys_in_firestore: Keys are stored encrypted in Firestore (and cached in the OS keyring).
models.keys_local: Keys are stored in the OS keyring. Once Firestore is active they are also saved there, encrypted.
models.no_profiles: No profiles yet: open a provider below and add a model.
models.not_loaded: Press “Load models” to list what your key can use.
models.providers_caption: Open a provider, save its key, then add models from the catalog or the live list.
models.search_hint: Live list from the provider API (cached 10 min). Filter by name or id.
models.workspace_hint: Anthropic: keys not scoped to a workspace must send the workspace id (Console → Settings → Workspaces, looks like wrkspc_…).
models.workspace_id: Workspace ID (only for org keys without a workspace)
param.extra_hint: Sent as-is to the provider API. Use it for anything not covered above.
profiles.cap_auto: Detected automatically from the catalog and the provider API.
profiles.cap_hint: Capabilities decide which parameters can be set. They come from the catalog or discovery and can be edited.
profiles.caption: A profile is a model plus its full configuration (reasoning, sampling, limits, price). It is the unit you compare.
profiles.pick_model: Pick or type a model id
profiles.price_auto: Prices come from the catalog or the provider (USD per million tokens).
profiles.rename_warning: This profile has results: comparisons pair results by profile name.
profiles.required: Name, provider and model id are required
profiles.title: Model profiles
providers.base_url_default: Leave empty to use the official endpoint.
providers.caption: API keys are stored in the OS keyring, never in the database.
providers.confirm_delete: Delete provider “{name}” and its saved key?
providers.key_env: Using the key from the environment variable.
providers.key_hint: Leave empty to keep the current key.
providers.title: Provider connections
rerun.title: Re-run “{name}”
rerun.use_current_hint: Off = exact same snapshot as the original run (strict reproducibility).
results.no_artifacts: No files were extracted from the answer.
results.no_checks: This task has no automatic checks.
results.no_judge: Not judged (no judge configured or disabled).
results.no_reasoning: The provider returned no reasoning text.
results.same_model_warning: Warning: the judge is the same model as the one evaluated.
results.user_hint: Your score (1-10) is final and overrides the judge preview.
review.caption: The judge pre-scores each answer; confirm or correct it. Your score is the final one.
review.title: Review queue
rules.caption: Instructions injected into the system prompt of every task of a battery.
rules.title: Rules
runs.caption: Every run keeps a snapshot of tasks, models and rules, so it can be repeated and compared.
runs.confirm_delete: Delete run “{name}” with its results and artifacts?
runs.estimate_reasoning_tip: Older Anthropic results did not record thinking tokens: estimate them as output − visible answer (free token count, no model call). Marked with ≈.
runs.matrix_hint: One chip per repetition. Outlined = not reviewed by you yet. Click to open.
runs.title: Runs
settings.firestore_caption: Upload the service-account JSON, test the connection and activate it. Collections use the aidriven_ prefix.
settings.fs_rules_note: The shared firestore.rules / indexes of the project are not modified. If a query needs an index, its creation link appears in Logs.
settings.fs_upload_hint: The file is copied to data/secrets/ (excluded from git) and never shown again.
settings.judge_caption: A stronger model pre-scores every result (1-10). You can correct it in Review.
settings.judge_hint: The judge never sees which model produced the answer. Configure it in Models like any other profile.
settings.sandbox_caption: Where artifacts, checks and agent tools run.
settings.sandbox_process_warning: Process mode isolates much less than Docker. Start Docker Desktop for full isolation.
settings.storage_caption: Artifacts are stored locally by default. Turn on the cloud to use Firebase Storage.
settings.storage_cloud: Store new artifacts in the cloud (Firebase Storage)
settings.storage_note: Uses the Firestore service account. Existing artifacts stay where they were stored.
suites.caption: A battery combines tasks, models, rules, an optional agent and repetitions.
suites.title: Batteries
tasks.caption: Add as many tasks as you want. Seed tasks are very hard and automatically verifiable.
tasks.checks_hint: Automatic checks in YAML. Sandbox checks use the aidriven_harness module (case/report).
tasks.checks_must_be_list: Checks must be a YAML list
tasks.confirm_delete_seed: “{slug}” is a seed task and will be restored on next start. Disable it instead? Delete anyway?
tasks.import_hint: Paste or upload YAML/JSON: one task or a list. An existing slug creates a new version.
tasks.prompt_hint: For answer tasks, ask for a last line “FINAL ANSWER: …”. For files, the delivery format is appended automatically.
tasks.reference_hint: Only the judge sees it; the evaluated model never does.
tasks.required: Slug, title and prompt are required
tasks.seed_note: Seed task: editing creates a new version; a newer seed release will replace it.
tasks.title: Title
tasks.try_checks: Try the checks against a sample answer
